tape: Default CSP screen returned 15 names. 6 are one bet: CIFR, CLSK, WULF, MARA, RIOT, IREN cluster at 0.7+ correlation, and none has reclaimed its gamma flip, so no miner is selling. RDW and PL are a second pair.
IV rank is under 15 on 11 of 15 names. Only CLF (61), MAT (100, 9-session sample), PSKY (46) and QXO (30) are higher.
The miners' IV sits right on 21-day realized vol (IV/HV 0.91 to 1.04) but 1.5x to 2x their 10-day realized. Their 21-day HV still holds the mid-September flush; the last two weeks were quiet.
Earnings feed covers through Nov 3. SMCI reports Nov 3, inside its Nov 6 expiry. NVTS and SMR also expire Nov 6, past the feed.
Gamma scan: 16 of 25 names in positive dealer gamma (pinning), 9 in negative (moves get amplified).
Institutional pull timed out tonight, so there is no fund-buying read this Sunday.
